claims.statement: Regulation 2024/3110 provides for interoperable construction passports containing performance, conformity, safety, and technical documentation.
The Commission says construction passports support reliable comparison and whole-building carbon calculations.

contrary_evidence: Generic DPP providers may cover construction products cheaply.

economics.acquisition_route: Unvalidated hypothesis: CE consultants, testing bodies, and BIM libraries.
economics.founder_net_worth_path: Unvalidated hypothesis: 1000 families at 9000 PLN annually yield 9 million PLN ARR and founder equity above 5 million PLN in five to seven years.
economics.founder_time: Unvalidated hypothesis: 12-18 hours weekly with contracted review.
economics.gross_margin_basis: Unvalidated hypothesis: 78% after storage and audit support.
economics.payback: Unvalidated hypothesis: first onboarding covers acquisition.
economics.pricing: Unvalidated hypothesis: 15000-50000 PLN onboarding plus 500-3000 PLN per family annually.
economics.retention_or_repeat: Unvalidated hypothesis: long availability, revisions, and embedded links make custody sticky.

fingerprint.compounding_advantage: Mappings lower onboarding friction while installed identifiers create switching costs
fingerprint.offer_and_business_model: Continuity-guaranteed passport vault per product family
fingerprint.payer_and_paid_event: The manufacturer pays at onboarding, revision, and annual custody
fingerprint.problem_trigger: A product needs a durable interoperable passport

founder_fit: Structured data automation is part-time compatible when legal expertise is contracted.
risks: Bad access controls could expose technical data.

structure.control_point: A product evidence graph with identifiers, access controls, BIM mappings, and continuity history
structure.critical_dependency: Recognition under final construction-passport service rules

thesis: A durable construction-product passport trustee preserves evidence, permissions, BIM links, and continuity for small manufacturers.
title: BuildPassport Vault
uncertainties: Final requirements and pre-purchase demand are unknown.
